# BOOM! Healthcare Communications

> BOOM! is an independent, award-winning healthcare communications agency of 65 specialists, with offices in London, Bournemouth and Copenhagen. It brings together the right people around each brief to help pharma, biotech and medtech teams build brands, educate audiences and drive advocacy, with experience across 300+ brands, 50+ launches and 70+ therapy areas.

- [Expertise](https://www.boom-cc.com/expertise): brand moments, specialist therapy areas and the full therapy area list
- [How we work](https://www.boom-cc.com/how-we-work): process, approvals and procurement information
- [About](https://www.boom-cc.com/about): values and why clients choose BOOM!

- [Contact](https://www.boom-cc.com/contact): enquiries, credentials, procurement and careers
